pf2e-timekeeping.paused-info: PF2e Timekeeping - Time advancement is paused, click to resume.
pf2e-timekeeping.unpaused-info: PF2e Timekeeping - Time advancement resumed, click to pause. The time will still be paused if the game is paused or if combat is active.
pf2e-timekeeping.calendar-dusk-dawn: This calendar includes dawn and dusk times, any value set in the settings or based on climate zone will be ignored and the calendar one will be used.

configuration.title: Configuration Menu

macrosFieldset.label: Automation Macros
macrosFieldset.hint: Macros run at the selected time of day as the active Gamemaster, if they have permission to execute them.

copyButton.label: Copy from current configuration (Save and reopen for formatting)

customCalendar.label: Custom Calendar JSON
customCalendar.hint: JSON Definition for the custom calendar. No support is provided for the custom calendar or on how to setup the JSON file. You can find some sample calendars on the wiki.
customCalendar.error: Invalid JSON format for the custom calendar, setting has been reverted to the previous state. Please check the console for more details.

customMoons.label: Custom Moons JSON
customMoons.hint: JSON Definition for the custom moons. While moons can also be defined in the calendar JSON, this allows you to override the moons without having to change the calendar JSON in cases where, for example, you are using a calendar defined by the system or another module and you want to add moons to it. No support is provided for the custom moons or on how to setup the JSON file see the wiki for examples.
customMoons.error: Invalid JSON format for the custom moons, setting has been reverted to the previous state. Please check the console for more details.

climateData.label: Climate Data
climateData.hint: JSON Definition for the weather and temperature generation. No support is provided for the custom climate or on how to setup the JSON file.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.hint: Custom calendar as defined in the Custom Calendar JSON

moonAutomation.label: Moon Phase Automation
moonAutomation.hint: If moons are defined in the calendar, PF2e Timekeeping will automatically update the moon badge with the current moon phase.

panelVisibility.label: Panel visibility
panelVisibility.hint: The GM’s choices apply to everyone. Hidden time, moon phases, and weather continue to update. The day counter can be hidden separately below.

dayOffset.label: Start Day Offset
dayOffset.hint: Offset to apply to the number of days when using the 'Since Start of Calendar' option in 'Days Display'

dawn.label: Dawn
dawn.hint: Time of day in percentage, for example if your day is 24 hours, 0.5 would be 12:00 and 0.25 would be 06:00

dusk.label: Dusk
dusk.hint: Time of day in percentage, for example if your day is 24 hours, 0.5 would be 12:00 and 0.75 would be 18:00

latitude.label: Climate Zone
latitude.hint: Select the climate zone for your world. If set it will be used to generate weather, temperature and dawn/dusk times (ignoring other dawn/dusk settings)

genWeather.label: Generate Weather
genWeather.hint: Generate a new weather every day. Uses Climate Zone to determine the climate.

hueIntensity.label: Scene Tint Intensity
hueIntensity.hint: When PF2e Timekeeping sets a darkness level, it will also apply a tint to the scene based on the day and night colors.

darknessSync.label: Sync Scene Darkness and Weather
darknessSync.hint: Whether scene darkness and weather should be set automatically based on the current time and weather. This option can also be configured per scene at the bottom of the lighting tab.

configuration.pf2eNotice: PF2e Timekeeping uses its own calendar. The PF2e system clock may show a different date. Choose one way to control lighting for each scene.

restWarnings.label: Post rest reminders in chat
restWarnings.hint: After PF2e’s Rest for the Night: one warning upon reaching 16 hours of world time. Advance the clock to the end of the rest first. No conditions are applied automatically. A connected GM is required to post the message.

day-back.tooltip: Back one Day (Ctrl 1 week, Shift 3 days, Alt 2 days)

day-forward.tooltip: Advance one Day (Ctrl 1 week, Shift 3 days, Alt 2 days)

errors.calendarJSON: PF2e Timekeeping: could not read the calendar. Check the JSON format in module settings.
errors.calendarDays: PF2e Timekeeping: the calendar specifies {declared} days per year, but its months add up to {actual}. Correct the calendar description.
errors.calendarApply: PF2e Timekeeping: could not apply the custom calendar. Check its description in module settings.
errors.moonsJSON: PF2e Timekeeping: could not read the moons. Check the JSON format in module settings.
errors.climateJSON: PF2e Timekeeping: could not read the climate data. Using the default climate.
errors.badgeNumber: Badge number must be between 1 and {max}.
errors.date: Could not display the date. Check the calendar settings.

athasian.name: Athasian (Dark Sun)
athasian.description: The Athasian calendar used in the Dark Sun setting. It has 10 months of 36 days each, with 5 festival days.

barovian.name: Barovian (Curse of Strahd)
barovian.description: The calendar used in the cursed land of Barovia, featured in the Curse of Strahd campaign. It features 12 months, each with 28 days.

cerilian.name: Cerilian Reckoning (Birthright)
cerilian.description: The calendar of Cerilia, used in the Birthright setting. 12 months, 30 days each, plus festivals.

commonyear.name: Common Year (Greyhawk)
commonyear.description: The Common Year calendar used in the World of Greyhawk setting, featuring 12 months of 28 days and four 7-day festivals.

ansalon.name: Dragonlance (Elves, Ansalon)
ansalon.description: The standard calendar used by the elves on the Ansalon continent, with 12 months of 28 days each. The Moons of Magic orbit around the world of Krynn, their cycle affecting Wizards of High Sorcery. The moon's cycle are named after how mages are affected.

drag_solamnia.name: Dragonlance (Solamnia, Ansalon)
drag_solamnia.description: The standard calendar used in Solamnia on the Ansalon continent, with 12 months of 28 days each. The Moons of Magic orbit around the world of Krynn, their cycle affecting Wizards of High Sorcery. The moon's cycle are named after how mages are affected.

drakkenheim.name: Drakkenheim (Drakkenheim)
drakkenheim.description: The calendar used in the Drakkenheim setting, based on the Gregorian calendar with unique names for days and months.

exandrian.name: Exandrian (Exandria)
exandrian.description: A calendar with 328 days over 11 months, used across Exandria. It features a 7-day week and seasonal shifts based on the northern hemisphere.

forbiddenlands.name: Forbidden Lands Calendar
forbiddenlands.description: The human celandar of the Forbidden Lands. Eight seasons with a seven day week and a moon.

galifar.name: Galifar (Eberron)
galifar.description: The calendar used in Eberron, featuring 12 months of 28 days and a consistent 7-day week with no leap years or intercalary days.

golarion.name: Golarion (Pathfinder)
golarion.description: The Absalom Reckoning calendar used in the Pathfinder setting, featuring 12 months with varying lengths and a 7-day week.

harptos.name: Harptos (Forgotten Realms)
harptos.description: The standard calendar of the Forgotten Realms, consisting of twelve 30-day months punctuated by five annual festival days.

imperial.name: Imperial Calendar (Warhammer)
imperial.description: The Imperial Calendar of the Old World, featuring 12 months and a 8-day week. Includes the two moons, Mannslieb and the erratic Morrslieb.

gregorian.name: Simplified Gregorian
gregorian.description: The Gregorian calendar with some simplifications regarding leap years or seasonal timing.

thyatian.name: Thyatian (Mystara)
thyatian.description: The Thyatian calendar used in the Mystara setting, closely resembling the Gregorian calendar with 12 months and a 7-day week.
